fit_reason: Whole private-party sedan for sale; the bad transmission is mechanical and not ours, but the car itself can be detailed.
findings: Black paint is fairly glossy overall, but reflections on the hood and front fender show light haze and fine swirling typical of black paint
Light dust and film on the lower doors and rocker area on the driver side
Headlight lenses look slightly cloudy and yellowed
Brake dust on the plastic wheel covers
Interior photo is shot through glare on the window, so the tan leather seats can only be partly judged; they look clean with light creasing
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the black Acura RL. It looks well kept, and a light buff would bring out the gloss on the black paint and clear up the slightly cloudy headlights. We do pre-sale details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
